notes: Self-join: the mapping holds TWO instances of the one source definition EMPLOYEES (instance EMPLOYEES and instance EMPLOYEES1, both TRANSFORMATION_NAME="EMPLOYEES"), each with its own Source Qualifier (SQ_EMP detail, SQ_MGR master). Both read the same table.
SQ_MGR's EMP_ID/EMP_NAME/SALARY feed the Joiner's master ports MGR_EMP_ID/MGR_NAME/MGR_SALARY (PORTTYPE="INPUT/OUTPUT/MASTER").

Join Condition MGR_EMP_ID = MGR_ID, Join Type 'Master Outer Join': every employee (detail) is kept; employees with no manager (Ada, MGR_ID NULL) or an unknown manager (Fox, MGR_ID 99) get NULL master ports.
Filter NOT ISNULL(MGR_EMP_ID) then drops those two rows.
SAL_RATIO = ROUND(SALARY / MGR_SALARY, 4): 160000/150000 = 1.0667; NULL on either side gives NULL (Gus's manager Hal has a NULL salary; Hal's own salary is NULL).
EARNS_MORE = IIF(SALARY > MGR_SALARY, 'Y', 'N'): a comparison with a NULL is NULL and IIF takes the FALSE branch, so Gus and Hal get 'N'.
